name: test-unit
description: Use this skill when writing, editing, or reviewing unit tests — Vitest, @testing-library/vue, composable testing, XCTest. Covers testing philosophy (happy and unhappy paths), what to skip (methods that delegate to @lewishowles/helpers), and meaningful assertions over snapshots. Always apply when working in *.test.js files or when the user mentions tests, specs, or coverage. For end-to-end tests, see the test-e2e skill if present.
when: When writing unit tests, Vitest, philosophy, what to skip
do-not-use-when: Running or interpreting an end-to-end, browser, or integration test
Discussing test strategy without writing, editing, or reviewing unit tests
Debugging production code where no test file or test assertion is being changed
